Name: No Ugly Shoes
Author: dogtre4t
Description:
[b][color=#ff7700]now with leprechaun shoes and updated manifest so smapi stops yelling @ u [/color][/b]

Are you [b]also[/b] sick of wearing the sickest (stat-wise) boots in this game and looking down to see that your feet are now purple or blue? Hey, me too.

Welcome to [b]No Ugly Shoes[/b];[b] [/b]the partially-modular* boots and shoes mod that makes everything more natural colors. We got brown shoes, we got black shoes, we got slightly-reddish-brown shoes, we got a completely custom icon for the Cinderclown Shoes because i hate them with my entire being. Sorry Emily, nobody** wants to wear pretty blue shoes while stomping around their farm.

[b]*Did you read partially-modular and are wondering what that means?[/b] Well well, lemme tell you. It means I don't know how to mod Stardew Valley properly so you can turn off the custom item icons but you can't also turn off the shoe color on your little guy in game. Sorry lol lmao. Also this only contains edits for the shoes that aren't already black/brown/neutral tones. 

[size=1]**me, i'm nobody.[/size]
